x2mesh_requirement.issue: set_pointload at intermediate elevation silently ignored if elevation not a mesh node
x2mesh_requirement.error_message: Load not applied! The chosen elevation is not meshed as a node. Please include elevation in x2mesh variable when creating the Model.
x2mesh_requirement.fix: Pass x2mesh=[list_of_midpoint_elevations] to Model() constructor before calling set_pointload
x2mesh_requirement.example:
mids = [(pts[k]+pts[k+1])/2 for k in range(len(pts)-1)]
model = Model(..., x2mesh=mids)
x2mesh_requirement.scope: Applies to ALL intermediate distributed loads (earth, water, Boussinesq). Head loads at top_elevation are always on a node.
x2mesh_requirement.verified: 2026-05-16 — without x2mesh: loads dropped, results = 0. With x2mesh: loads applied, converged.
